openapi: "3.1.0"
info:
  title: Open LOS API
  description: Open source B2B Lending CRM — headless API
  version: "0.1.0"
  license:
    name: MIT

servers:
  - url: http://localhost:3000
    description: Local development

paths:
  # ── Deals ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  /v1/deals:
    post:
      operationId: createDeal
      summary: Create a new deal
      tags: [deals]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateDealRequest"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Deal created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Deal"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/ValidationError"
    get:
      operationId: listDeals
      summary: List deals with filters
      tags: [deals]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/PageLimit"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/PageCursor"
        - name: stage
          in: query
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Paginated deal list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/DealList"

  /v1/deals/{dealId}:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    get:
      operationId: getDeal
      summary: Get deal by ID
      tags: [deals]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Deal details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Deal"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFoundError"
    patch:
      operationId: updateDeal
      summary: Update deal fields
      tags: [deals]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/UpdateDealRequest"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Deal updated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Deal"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/ValidationError"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFoundError"

  # ── Stage Transitions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  /v1/deals/{dealId}/stage-transitions:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    post:
      operationId: transitionStage
      summary: Transition deal to a new stage
      tags: [stages]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/StageTransitionRequest"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Transition succeeded
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/StageTransition"
        "409":
          description: Transition blocked by guard
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiError"
    get:
      operationId: listStageTransitions
      summary: List stage transition history
      tags: [stages]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Stage transition history
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  transitions:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/StageTransition"

  # ── Documents ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  /v1/deals/{dealId}/documents:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    post:
      operationId: uploadDocument
      summary: Upload a document to a deal
      tags: [documents]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [file, meta]
              properties:
                file:
                  type: string
                  format: binary
                meta:
                  type: string
                  description: JSON string with doc_type, phase, label
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateDocumentRequest"
      responses:
        "202":
          description: Document accepted for processing
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Document"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/ValidationError"
    get:
      operationId: listDocuments
      summary: List documents for a deal
      tags: [documents]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Document list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  documents:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/Document"

  /v1/documents/{documentId}:
    parameters:
      - name: documentId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          format: uuid
    get:
      operationId: getDocument
      summary: Get document metadata
      tags: [documents]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Document details
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Document"

  /v1/documents/{documentId}/versions:
    parameters:
      - name: documentId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          format: uuid
    get:
      operationId: listDocumentVersions
      summary: List document versions
      tags: [documents]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Version history
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  versions:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        version:
                          type: integer
                        created_at:
                          type: string
                          format: date-time
                        created_by:
                          type: string
                        checksum:
                          type: string

  # ── Audit ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  /v1/deals/{dealId}/audit:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    get:
      operationId: listAuditEvents
      summary: List audit events for a deal
      tags: [audit]
      parameters:
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/PageLimit"
        - $ref: "#/components/parameters/PageCursor"
        - name: type
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: actor
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Audit event list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [events, total]
                properties:
                  events:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/AuditEvent"
                  total:
                    type: integer
                  cursor:
                    type: string

  # ── Entities ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  /v1/entities:
    post:
      operationId: createEntity
      summary: Create an entity (company or person)
      tags: [entities]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateEntityRequest"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Entity created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Entity"
    get:

            application/json:

  /v1/entities/{entityId}:

    get:

    patch:

  # ── Relationships ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

      requestBody:

        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateRelationshipRequest"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Relationship created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Relationship"

  /v1/deals/{dealId}/borrower-group:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    get:
      operationId: getBorrowerGroup
      summary: Get the borrower group graph for a deal

                    items:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/Entity"

                    items:

  # ── Templates ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  /v1/templates:
    get:
      operationId: listTemplates
      summary: List available templates
      tags: [templates]
      parameters:
        - name: phase
          in: query
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        - name: doc_type
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Template list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  templates:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/Template"

  /v1/templates/render:
    post:
      operationId: renderTemplate
      summary: Render a template with deal context
      tags: [templates]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [template_id, deal_id]
              properties:
                template_id:
                  type: string
                deal_id:
                  type: string
                  format: uuid
                overrides:
                  type: object
                  additionalProperties: true
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Rendered template
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [markdown, template_version]
                properties:
                  markdown:
                    type: string
                  html:
                    type: string
                  template_version:
                    type: string

  /v1/deals/{dealId}/artifacts:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    get:
      operationId: listArtifacts
      summary: List frozen artifacts for a deal
      tags: [templates]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Artifact list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  artifacts:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      required: [id, template_id, deal_id, frozen_at, markdown]
                      properties:
                        id:
                          type: string
                          format: uuid
                        template_id:
                          type: string
                        deal_id:
                          type: string
                          format: uuid
                        frozen_at:
                          type: string
                          format: date-time
                        template_version:
                          type: string
                        markdown:
                          type: string
    post:
      operationId: freezeArtifact
      summary: Freeze a rendered template as an immutable artifact
      tags: [templates]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [template_id]
              properties:
                template_id:
                  type: string
                overrides:
                  type: object
                  additionalProperties: true
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Artifact frozen
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [id, frozen_at]
                properties:
                  id:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
                  frozen_at:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time

  # ── Underwriting / Spread ──────────────────────────────────────────────
  /v1/deals/{dealId}/spread:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    post:
      operationId: createSpread
      summary: Ingest financial data and compute spread
      tags: [underwriting]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [file]
              properties:
                file:
                  type: string
                  format: binary
                entity_id:
                  type: string
                  format: uuid
                period:
                  type: string
                  description: "e.g. FY2024, H1-2025"
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [entity_id, period, line_items]
              properties:
                entity_id:
                  type: string
                  format: uuid
                period:
                  type: string
                line_items:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: object
                    required: [category, label, amount]
                    properties:
                      category:
                        type: string
                      label:
                        type: string
                      amount:
                        type: integer
                        description: Minor units (cents/pence)
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Spread computed
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [spread_id, ratios]
                properties:
                  spread_id:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
                  entity_id:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
                  period:
                    type: string
                  line_items:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                  ratios:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      current_ratio:
                        type: number
                      debt_to_equity:
                        type: number
                      dscr:
                        type: number
                      gross_margin:
                        type: number
                      net_margin:
                        type: number
                      leverage:
                        type: number

  /v1/deals/{dealId}/ratios:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    get:
      operationId: getRatios
      summary: Get computed financial ratios for a deal
      tags: [underwriting]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Ratio summary
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  ratios:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        entity_id:
                          type: string
                          format: uuid
                        period:
                          type: string
                        current_ratio:
                          type: number
                        debt_to_equity:
                          type: number
                        dscr:
                          type: number
                        gross_margin:
                          type: number

  # ── Evaluate (Underwriting) ────────────────────────────────────────────
  /v1/deals/{dealId}/evaluate:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    post:
      operationId: evaluateDeal
      summary: Trigger underwriting evaluation for a deal
      description: |
        Triggers underwriting evaluation for the deal using the provided policy
        configuration. Returns a structured UnderwritingRun conforming to
        `schemas/underwriting-run.schema.json`.

        Current implementation is the deterministic thin-agent rules path.
        `mode=full` is accepted for forward compatibility and currently falls
        back to the same rules evaluation as `mode=rules_only`.
      tags: [underwriting]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/EvaluateRequest"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Evaluation completed
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/EvaluateResponse"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/ValidationError"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFoundError"

  # ── Covenants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  /v1/deals/{dealId}/covenants:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    post:
      operationId: createCovenant
      summary: Add a covenant to a deal

      requestBody:

        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateCovenantRequest"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Covenant created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Covenant"
    get:
      operationId: listCovenants
      summary: List covenants for a deal
      tags: [covenants]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Covenant list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  covenants:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/Covenant"

  /v1/deals/{dealId}/covenants/test:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    post:
      operationId: testCovenants
      summary: Run covenant tests against current data
      tags: [covenants]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                as_of:
                  type: string
                  format: date-time
                covenant_ids:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Covenant test results
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [results]
                properties:
                  results:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/CovenantTestResult"

  /v1/covenants/{covenantId}/waivers:

          format: uuid
    post:

      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [reason, approved_by]
              properties:
                reason:
                  type: string
                approved_by:
                  type: string
                valid_from:
                  type: string
                  format: date-time
                valid_until:
                  type: string
                  format: date-time
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Waiver recorded
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [id, covenant_id, reason, approved_by, created_at]
                properties:
                  id:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
                  covenant_id:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
                  reason:
                    type: string
                  approved_by:
                    type: string
                  valid_from:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time
                  valid_until:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time
                  created_at:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time

  # ── Monitoring ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  /v1/deals/{dealId}/monitoring/ingest:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    post:
      operationId: ingestMonitoringData
      summary: Ingest bank transactions or accounting data
      tags: [monitoring]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [file, source_type]
              properties:
                file:
                  type: string
                  format: binary
                source_type:
                  type: string
                  enum: [bank_transactions, accounting]
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [source_type, transactions]
              properties:
                source_type:
                  type: string
                  enum: [bank_transactions, accounting]
                transactions:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: object
                    required: [date, amount, description]
                    properties:
                      date:
                        type: string
                        format: date
                      amount:
                        type: integer
                        description: Minor units, negative for debits
                      description:
                        type: string
                      category:
                        type: string
      responses:
        "202":
          description: Data accepted for processing
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  ingestion_id:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
                  records_accepted:
                    type: integer

  /v1/deals/{dealId}/monitoring/status:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    get:

      tags: [monitoring]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Monitoring status

            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object

                    format: uuid
                  liquidity:

                    properties:

                    items:

                          format: uuid

                        severity:
                          type: string
                          enum: [info, warning, critical]
                        message:
                          type: string
                        created_at:
                          type: string
                          format: date-time

                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/CovenantTestResult"

  /v1/email/ingest:

      operationId: ingestEmail

      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:

            schema:
              type: object
              required: [file]
              properties:

                  format: binary

                    format: uuid

      responses:
        "200":

          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  communications:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        id:
                          type: string
                          format: uuid
                        type:
                          type: string
                          enum: [email, note, meeting]
                        subject:
                          type: string
                        from:
                          type: string
                        to:
                          type: array
                          items:
                            type: string
                        body:
                          type: string
                        thread_id:
                          type: string
                        attachments:
                          type: array
                          items:
                            type: string
                            format: uuid
                        created_at:
                          type: string
                          format: date-time

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Components
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
components:
  parameters:
    DealId:
      name: dealId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    PageLimit:
      name: limit
      in: query
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        maximum: 100
        default: 50
    PageCursor:
      name: cursor
      in: query
      schema:
        type: string

  responses:
    ValidationError:
      description: Validation error
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiError"
    NotFoundError:
      description: Resource not found
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiError"

  schemas:
    # ── Stages ──
    Stage:
      type: string
      enum: [broker, origination, underwriting, closing, monitoring]

    OriginationOutcome:
      type: string
      enum: [reject, need_info, proceed, refer]

    # ── Deal ──
    Deal:
      type: object
      required: [id, tenant_id, borrower_name, stage, created_at, updated_at]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        tenant_id:
          type: string
        borrower_name:
          type: string
        borrower_registration_number:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string
        requested_amount:
          type: integer
          description: Minor units
        purpose:
          type: string
        stage:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        origination_outcome:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/OriginationOutcome"
        assigned_to:
          type: string
        primary_entity_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        custom_fields:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    CreateDealRequest:
      type: object
      required: [borrower_name]
      properties:
        borrower_name:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string
        requested_amount:
          type: integer
        purpose:
          type: string
        borrower_registration_number:
          type: string
        assigned_to:
          type: string
        custom_fields:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true

    UpdateDealRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        borrower_name:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string
        requested_amount:
          type: integer
        purpose:
          type: string
        borrower_registration_number:
          type: string
        assigned_to:
          type: string
        origination_outcome:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/OriginationOutcome"
        custom_fields:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true

    DealList:
      type: object
      required: [deals, total]
      properties:
        deals:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Deal"
        total:
          type: integer
        cursor:
          type: string

    # ── Stage Transition ──
    StageTransitionRequest:
      type: object
      required: [to_stage]
      properties:
        to_stage:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        rationale:
          type: string
        override:
          type: boolean
          default: false
        override_rationale:
          type: string

    StageTransition:
      type: object
      required: [id, deal_id, from_stage, to_stage, actor, transitioned_at]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        deal_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        from_stage:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        to_stage:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        actor:
          type: string
        rationale:
          type: string
        override:
          type: boolean
        override_rationale:
          type: string
        checklist_snapshot:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              item:
                type: string
              satisfied:
                type: boolean
        transitioned_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    # ── Document ──
    Document:
      type: object
      required: [id, deal_id, doc_type, filename, created_at]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        deal_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        doc_type:
          type: string
        phase:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        filename:
          type: string
        label:
          type: string
        mime_type:
          type: string
        size_bytes:
          type: integer
        checksum:
          type: string
        version:
          type: integer
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        created_by:
          type: string

    CreateDocumentRequest:
      type: object
      required: [doc_type, filename, content_base64]
      properties:
        doc_type:
          type: string
        phase:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        filename:
          type: string
        label:
          type: string
        content_base64:
          type: string
          format: byte

    # ── Audit Event ──
    AuditEvent:
      type: object
      required: [id, deal_id, type, actor, timestamp]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        deal_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        type:
          type: string
          description: "e.g. DEAL_CREATED, DEAL_UPDATED, STAGE_TRANSITION, DOCUMENT_UPLOADED"
        actor:
          type: string
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        object_type:
          type: string
        object_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        changes:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              field:
                type: string
              before:
                {}
              after:
                {}
        metadata:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true

    # ── Entity ──
    Entity:
      type: object
      required: [id, type, name, created_at]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [company, person]
        name:
          type: string
        legal_name:
          type: string
        registration_number:
          type: string
        lei:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string
        identifiers:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              scheme:
                type: string
              value:
                type: string
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    CreateEntityRequest:
      type: object
      required: [type, name]
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [company, person]
        name:
          type: string
        legal_name:
          type: string
        registration_number:
          type: string
        lei:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string
        identifiers:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required: [scheme, value]
            properties:
              scheme:
                type: string
              value:
                type: string

    UpdateEntityRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        legal_name:
          type: string
        registration_number:
          type: string
        lei:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string

    # ── Relationship ──
    Relationship:
      type: object
      required: [id, from_entity_id, to_entity_id, type, created_at]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        from_entity_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        to_entity_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [owns, guarantees, directs]
        ownership_pct:
          type: number
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 100
        metadata:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    CreateRelationshipRequest:
      type: object

content.text:
# AGENTS.md — Open LOS

> Open-source B2B Lending CRM. Headless API designed for AI-native workflows.

## Quick Links

- **UI Prototype**: Use [Primer](https://github.com/pierceboggan/primer.git) to scaffold a frontend
- **Flow Diagrams**: Use https://agents.craft.do/mermaid to diagram this application's flows

## Project Overview

Open LOS is a headless lending data platform that serves as the source of truth for B2B lending operations. It is designed to be operated equally by:

- **Humans** via a web UI
- **AI agents** via MCP (Model Context Protocol) or REST API
- **Automated systems** via webhooks and scheduled jobs

The platform does not contain AI "smarts" internally. Instead, it provides a complete, well-structured API that external AI tools can operate against.

### Key Insight

> The backend is like a **domain-aware database**. It knows what a valid stage transition is, computes ratios deterministically, enforces permissions, and logs everything. But it doesn't think—thinking happens in external AI environments that the user controls.

## Tech Stack

| Layer | Choice |
|-------|--------|
| Language | TypeScript (strict mode) |
| HTTP framework | Hono |
| ORM | Drizzle (SQLite for tests, Postgres for prod) |
| Test runner | Vitest |
| Monorepo | npm workspaces |
| Node | >= 20 |

## Repository Structure

```
packages/
  core/           # Domain logic: schemas, state machine, computations
  api/            # Hono HTTP server, routes, middleware
  conformance/    # YAML test runner + conformance suites

openapi/          # OpenAPI v1.yaml
schemas/          # JSON Schema files (*.schema.json)

conformance/
  cases/          # YAML conformance test files
  fixtures/       # Fixture data (deals, templates, etc.)

docs/             # Architecture documentation
prompts/          # Per-phase Ralph loop prompts (if used)
```

## Setup

```bash
# Clone the repo
git clone <repo-url>
cd open-los

# Install dependencies
npm install

# Run tests (161 conformance tests)
npm test

# Start the API server
npm run start --workspace=packages/api

# Or with persistent database
DB_PATH=./data.db npm run start --workspace=packages/api
```

### Setting Up a UI with Primer

To scaffold a frontend for Open LOS:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/pierceboggan/primer.git
cd primer
npm install
```

Then connect it to the Open LOS API running on `http://localhost:3000`.

## Domain Model

### Deal Lifecycle (5 stages)

```
broker → origination → underwriting → closing → monitoring
```

| Stage | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| **Broker** | Inbound portal, document upload, intake |
| **Origination** | Deal triage, qualification, assignment |
| **Underwriting** | Deep analysis, spreads, ratios, approval workflow |
| **Closing** | Doc generation, e-sign, covenant setup |
| **Monitoring** | Bank data ingestion, covenant testing, alerts |

### Core Objects

- **Deal** — A lending opportunity moving through stages
- **Entity** — Company or person (borrower, guarantor, director)
- **Relationship** — Links between entities (owns, guarantees, directs)
- **Document** — Uploaded files with versioning
- **Spread** — Structured financial statement with line items
- **Covenant** — Contractual tests (DSCR, leverage, liquidity)
- **Audit Event** — Immutable log of all mutations

## Coding Standards

### General

- Use `import type` for type-only imports
- Prefer named exports over default exports
- Use `const` by default; `let` only when mutation is needed
- No `any` types — use `unknown` and narrow
- IDs are UUIDs (v7 preferred for sortability)
- Timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC strings
- Money amounts are integers in minor units (cents/pence)

### API Responses

- All responses must match their JSON Schema in `schemas/`
- Error types must match `schemas/error.schema.json`
- Include `_context` hints for AI consumption (available actions, warnings)

### Mutations

- All mutations must produce audit events
- Stage transitions must go through the stage machine (no direct DB updates to `stage`)
- Every mutation records who did it (human or AI), when, and what changed

## Test Commands

```bash
# Full test suite
npm test

# Conformance tests only
npm run test:conformance

# Smoke tests only (fast, CI gate)
npm run test:smoke

# Type checking
npm run typecheck

# Watch mode
npm run dev --workspace=packages/api
```

## Conformance Test DSL

Tests in `conformance/cases/*.yaml` use a YAML DSL:

```yaml
name: "Deal stage transition"
arrange:
  tenant: { id: "t1" }
  deals:
    - id: "d1"
      borrower_name: "Acme Ltd"
      stage: "broker"

steps:
  - name: "Transition to origination"
    request:
      method: POST
      path: /v1/deals/d1/stage-transitions
      headers:
        X-Actor: alice
      body:
        to_stage: origination
    expect:
      status: 200
      body:
        from_stage: broker
        to_stage: origination
```

The conformance runner starts a fresh server + SQLite DB per test file.

## Key Invariants

1. **Every mutation produces an immutable audit event**
2. **Stage transitions are guarded by the state machine**
3. **Covenants and ratios are deterministic** (no AI in computation path)
4. **Templates render to Markdown** with mustache variable injection
5. **All API responses validate against their JSON Schema**
6. **Time is injectable** (tests freeze time via `meta.now`)

## Time Injection

All services accept a `getNow: () => string` function for testability.

```typescript
// In tests
const fixedTime = "2024-01-15T10:00:00Z";
const { app } = await createAppWithDb(() => fixedTime);

// In production
const getNow = () => new Date().toISOString();
```

## API Design for AI Consumption

### Actor Identification

Every request identifies the actor via headers:

```
X-Actor: alice@lender.com
X-Actor-Type: human
X-Tenant-Id: tenant_123
```

For AI agents:
```
X-Actor: claude-code
X-Actor-Type: ai
X-Actor-AI-Provider: anthropic
X-Actor-Session: session_abc123
```

### Response Format

Responses include contextual hints for AI reasoning:

```json
{
  "data": { ... },
  "_context": {
    "available_actions": [
      { "tool": "deal.transition_stage", "description": "Move to underwriting" }
    ],
    "warnings": [
      { "code": "MISSING_GUARANTOR", "message": "No personal guarantor linked" }
    ],
    "related": [
      { "resource": "deal://deal_abc123/documents" }
    ]
  }
}
```

## MCP Integration

Open LOS exposes tools via MCP for AI agents:

| Tool Category | Examples |
|---------------|----------|
| **Deal lifecycle** | `deal.create`, `deal.get`, `deal.transition_stage` |
| **Documents** | `document.upload`, `document.read`, `document.classify` |
| **Financial** | `spread.create`, `covenant.create`, `covenant.test` |
| **Monitoring** | `monitoring.ingest`, `monitoring.status` |

## Shadow Migration Validation

Open LOS includes a **Shadow Migration** system that lets enterprises validate Open LOS as a system of record replacement by running it in parallel with their existing LOS (Mambu, nCino, etc.).

### Purpose

- **Zero-risk validation**: Prove data coverage before any production cutover
- **Feature parity check**: Identify gaps between source and Open LOS
- **Migration confidence**: Build trust with stakeholders through parallel validation
- **Live data testing**: Use real production data to validate (read-only from source)

### Quick Start (Claude Code)

When a user asks to set up shadow migration, follow these steps:

```
User: Set up Open LOS to validate against our Mambu instance

Claude: I'll help you set up Open LOS shadow migration. Let me:

1. Check your infrastructure (Docker/K8s/bare metal)
2. Initialize the shadow environment
3. Configure the Mambu adapter
4. Run initial sync and validation
```

### CLI Commands

```bash
# Initialize shadow environment
npx open-los-shadow init --adapter=mambu

# Connect to source system
npx open-los-shadow connect --url=https://acme.mambu.com --api-key=$MAMBU_API_KEY

# Run full sync
npx open-los-shadow sync --mode=full

# Run validation
npx open-los-shadow validate

# Check readiness score
npx open-los-shadow status

# Generate report
npx open-los-shadow report --format=pdf --output=./migration-readiness.pdf
```

### Supported Source Systems

| System | Adapter | Sync Mode | Notes |
|--------|---------|-----------|-------|
| **Mambu** | `mambu` | Incremental + CDC | Full loan account support |
| **nCino** | `ncino` | Incremental | Salesforce API |
| **CSV Export** | `csv` | Full | File-based import |
| **Webhook** | `webhook` | Real-time | Push from source |
| **Custom API** | `custom_api` | Configurable | Build your own |

### Shadow API Endpoints

| Endpoint | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `POST /v1/shadow/connections` | Create source connection |
| `POST /v1/shadow/connections/{id}/test` | Test connection |
| `GET /v1/shadow/connections/{id}/discover` | Discover source schema |
| `POST /v1/shadow/mappings` | Configure field mappings |
| `POST /v1/shadow/sync` | Trigger sync operation |
| `POST /v1/shadow/validation` | Run validation comparison |
| `GET /v1/shadow/readiness` | Get migration readiness score |
| `GET /v1/shadow/report` | Generate detailed report |

### Migration Readiness Score

The system calculates a composite readiness score (0-100):

```
Readiness = (Coverage × 0.4) + (Accuracy × 0.4) + (Gap Score × 0.2)
```

| Score | Status |
|-------|--------|
| 90-100 | Ready for migration |
| 70-89 | Minor issues to resolve |
| 50-69 | Significant work needed |
| <50 | Major gaps, not ready |

### Setup Flow for Claude Code

When helping a user set up shadow migration:

1. **Detect Infrastructure**
   ```bash
   docker --version  # Check for Docker
   kubectl version   # Check for Kubernetes
   node --version    # Ensure Node.js 20+
   ```

2. **Initialize Environment**
   ```bash
   npx open-los-shadow init --adapter=mambu --directory=./shadow
   ```

3. **Configure Connection**
   - Ask for source system URL
   - Ask for API credentials (store in `.env.shadow`)
   - Test connection before proceeding

4. **Run Initial Sync**
   ```bash
   npx open-los-shadow sync --mode=full
   ```

5. **Validate and Report**
   ```bash
   npx open-los-shadow validate
   npx open-los-shadow report --format=json
   ```

alerts:

                          type: string
                        current_ratio:
                          type: number
                        debt_to_equity:
                          type: number
                        dscr:
                          type: number
                        gross_margin:
                          type: number

  # ── Evaluate (Underwriting) ────────────────────────────────────────────
  /v1/deals/{dealId}/evaluate:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    post:
      operationId: evaluateDeal
      summary: Trigger underwriting evaluation for a deal
      description: |
        Triggers underwriting evaluation for the deal using the provided policy
        configuration. Returns a structured UnderwritingRun conforming to
        `schemas/underwriting-run.schema.json`.

        Current implementation is the deterministic thin-agent rules path.
        `mode=full` is accepted for forward compatibility and currently falls
        back to the same rules evaluation as `mode=rules_only`.
      tags: [underwriting]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/EvaluateRequest"
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Evaluation completed
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/EvaluateResponse"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/ValidationError"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFoundError"

  # ── Covenants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  /v1/deals/{dealId}/covenants:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    post:
      operationId: createCovenant
      summary: Add a covenant to a deal
      tags: [covenants]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/CreateCovenantRequest"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Covenant created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Covenant"
    get:
      operationId: listCovenants
      summary: List covenants for a deal
      tags: [covenants]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Covenant list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  covenants:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/Covenant"

  /v1/deals/{dealId}/covenants/test:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    post:
      operationId: testCovenants
      summary: Run covenant tests against current data
      tags: [covenants]
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                as_of:
                  type: string
                  format: date-time
                covenant_ids:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Covenant test results
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [results]
                properties:
                  results:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/CovenantTestResult"

  /v1/covenants/{covenantId}/waivers:
    parameters:
      - name: covenantId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          format: uuid
    post:
      operationId: createWaiver
      summary: Record a covenant waiver
      tags: [covenants]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [reason, approved_by]
              properties:
                reason:
                  type: string
                approved_by:
                  type: string
                valid_from:
                  type: string
                  format: date-time
                valid_until:
                  type: string
                  format: date-time
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Waiver recorded
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [id, covenant_id, reason, approved_by, created_at]
                properties:
                  id:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
                  covenant_id:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
                  reason:
                    type: string
                  approved_by:
                    type: string
                  valid_from:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time
                  valid_until:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time
                  created_at:
                    type: string
                    format: date-time

  # ── Monitoring ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  /v1/deals/{dealId}/monitoring/ingest:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    post:
      operationId: ingestMonitoringData
      summary: Ingest bank transactions or accounting data
      tags: [monitoring]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [file, source_type]
              properties:
                file:
                  type: string
                  format: binary
                source_type:
                  type: string
                  enum: [bank_transactions, accounting]
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [source_type, transactions]
              properties:
                source_type:
                  type: string
                  enum: [bank_transactions, accounting]
                transactions:
                  type: array
                  items:
                    type: object
                    required: [date, amount, description]
                    properties:
                      date:
                        type: string
                        format: date
                      amount:
                        type: integer
                        description: Minor units, negative for debits
                      description:
                        type: string
                      category:
                        type: string
      responses:
        "202":
          description: Data accepted for processing
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  ingestion_id:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
                  records_accepted:
                    type: integer

  /v1/deals/{dealId}/monitoring/status:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    get:
      operationId: getMonitoringStatus
      summary: Get monitoring status including liquidity and alerts
      tags: [monitoring]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Monitoring status
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [deal_id, liquidity, alerts, covenant_status]
                properties:
                  deal_id:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
                  liquidity:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      current_balance:
                        type: integer
                      avg_monthly_burn:
                        type: integer
                      runway_months:
                        type: number
                      as_of:
                        type: string
                        format: date-time
                  alerts:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        id:
                          type: string
                          format: uuid
                        type:
                          type: string
                          enum: [covenant_breach, liquidity_warning, data_gap, payment_missed]
                        severity:
                          type: string
                          enum: [info, warning, critical]
                        message:
                          type: string
                        created_at:
                          type: string
                          format: date-time
                  covenant_status:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      $ref: "#/components/schemas/CovenantTestResult"

  # ── Email Ingest ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  /v1/email/ingest:
    post:
      operationId: ingestEmail
      summary: Ingest an email (.eml) and link to deal
      tags: [email]
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [file]
              properties:
                file:
                  type: string
                  format: binary
                  description: ".eml file"
                deal_id:
                  type: string
                  format: uuid
                  description: "Optional — system will try to auto-link if omitted"
      responses:
        "202":
          description: Email accepted
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                required: [communication_id]
                properties:
                  communication_id:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
                  deal_id:
                    type: string
                    format: uuid
                    description: Linked deal (may be null if auto-link fails)
                  subject:
                    type: string
                  from:
                    type: string
                  attachments:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        document_id:
                          type: string
                          format: uuid
                        filename:
                          type: string

  /v1/deals/{dealId}/communications:
    parameters:
      - $ref: "#/components/parameters/DealId"
    get:
      operationId: listCommunications
      summary: List communications (emails, notes) for a deal
      tags: [email]
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Communication list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  communications:
                    type: array
                    items:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        id:
                          type: string
                          format: uuid
                        type:
                          type: string
                          enum: [email, note, meeting]
                        subject:
                          type: string
                        from:
                          type: string
                        to:
                          type: array
                          items:
                            type: string
                        body:
                          type: string
                        thread_id:
                          type: string
                        attachments:
                          type: array
                          items:
                            type: string
                            format: uuid
                        created_at:
                          type: string
                          format: date-time

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Components
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
components:
  parameters:
    DealId:
      name: dealId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
        format: uuid
    PageLimit:
      name: limit
      in: query
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
        maximum: 100
        default: 50
    PageCursor:
      name: cursor
      in: query
      schema:
        type: string

  responses:
    ValidationError:
      description: Validation error
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiError"
    NotFoundError:
      description: Resource not found
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiError"

  schemas:
    # ── Stages ──
    Stage:
      type: string
      enum: [broker, origination, underwriting, closing, monitoring]

    OriginationOutcome:
      type: string
      enum: [reject, need_info, proceed, refer]

    # ── Deal ──
    Deal:
      type: object
      required: [id, tenant_id, borrower_name, stage, created_at, updated_at]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        tenant_id:
          type: string
        borrower_name:
          type: string
        borrower_registration_number:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string
        requested_amount:
          type: integer
          description: Minor units
        purpose:
          type: string
        stage:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        origination_outcome:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/OriginationOutcome"
        assigned_to:
          type: string
        primary_entity_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        custom_fields:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    CreateDealRequest:
      type: object
      required: [borrower_name]
      properties:
        borrower_name:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string
        requested_amount:
          type: integer
        purpose:
          type: string
        borrower_registration_number:
          type: string
        assigned_to:
          type: string
        custom_fields:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true

    UpdateDealRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        borrower_name:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string
        requested_amount:
          type: integer
        purpose:
          type: string
        borrower_registration_number:
          type: string
        assigned_to:
          type: string
        origination_outcome:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/OriginationOutcome"
        custom_fields:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true

    DealList:
      type: object
      required: [deals, total]
      properties:
        deals:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/Deal"
        total:
          type: integer
        cursor:
          type: string

    # ── Stage Transition ──
    StageTransitionRequest:
      type: object
      required: [to_stage]
      properties:
        to_stage:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        rationale:
          type: string
        override:
          type: boolean
          default: false
        override_rationale:
          type: string

    StageTransition:
      type: object
      required: [id, deal_id, from_stage, to_stage, actor, transitioned_at]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        deal_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        from_stage:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        to_stage:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        actor:
          type: string
        rationale:
          type: string
        override:
          type: boolean
        override_rationale:
          type: string
        checklist_snapshot:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              item:
                type: string
              satisfied:
                type: boolean
        transitioned_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    # ── Document ──
    Document:
      type: object
      required: [id, deal_id, doc_type, filename, created_at]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        deal_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        doc_type:
          type: string
        phase:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        filename:
          type: string
        label:
          type: string
        mime_type:
          type: string
        size_bytes:
          type: integer
        checksum:
          type: string
        version:
          type: integer
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        created_by:
          type: string

    CreateDocumentRequest:
      type: object
      required: [doc_type, filename, content_base64]
      properties:
        doc_type:
          type: string
        phase:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        filename:
          type: string
        label:
          type: string
        content_base64:
          type: string
          format: byte

    # ── Audit Event ──
    AuditEvent:
      type: object
      required: [id, deal_id, type, actor, timestamp]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        deal_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        type:
          type: string
          description: "e.g. DEAL_CREATED, DEAL_UPDATED, STAGE_TRANSITION, DOCUMENT_UPLOADED"
        actor:
          type: string
        timestamp:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        object_type:
          type: string
        object_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        changes:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              field:
                type: string
              before:
                {}
              after:
                {}
        metadata:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true

    # ── Entity ──
    Entity:
      type: object
      required: [id, type, name, created_at]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [company, person]
        name:
          type: string
        legal_name:
          type: string
        registration_number:
          type: string
        lei:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string
        identifiers:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              scheme:
                type: string
              value:
                type: string
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    CreateEntityRequest:
      type: object
      required: [type, name]
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [company, person]
        name:
          type: string
        legal_name:
          type: string
        registration_number:
          type: string
        lei:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string
        identifiers:
          type: array
          items:
            type: object
            required: [scheme, value]
            properties:
              scheme:
                type: string
              value:
                type: string

    UpdateEntityRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        legal_name:
          type: string
        registration_number:
          type: string
        lei:
          type: string
        jurisdiction:
          type: string

    # ── Relationship ──
    Relationship:
      type: object
      required: [id, from_entity_id, to_entity_id, type, created_at]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        from_entity_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        to_entity_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [owns, guarantees, directs]
        ownership_pct:
          type: number
          minimum: 0
          maximum: 100
        metadata:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    CreateRelationshipRequest:
      type: object
      required: [from_entity_id, to_entity_id, type]
      properties:
        from_entity_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        to_entity_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [owns, guarantees, directs]
        ownership_pct:
          type: number
        metadata:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true

    # ── Template ──
    Template:
      type: object
      required: [id, name, phase, doc_type, version]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
        name:
          type: string
        phase:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/Stage"
        doc_type:
          type: string
        version:
          type: string
        frontmatter:
          type: object
          additionalProperties: true
        body:
          type: string
          description: Markdown template body with mustache variables

    # ── Covenant ──
    Covenant:
      type: object
      required: [id, deal_id, name, type, metric, operator, threshold]
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        deal_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [financial, reporting, information]
        metric:
          type: string
          description: "e.g. dscr, leverage, min_liquidity, gross_margin"
        operator:
          type: string
          enum: [">=", "<=", ">", "<", "=="]
        threshold:
          type: number
        frequency:
          type: string
          enum: [monthly, quarterly, annually]
        grace_period_days:
          type: integer
          default: 0
        notes:
          type: string
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    CreateCovenantRequest:
      type: object
      required: [name, type, metric, operator, threshold]
      properties:
        name:
          type: string
        type:
          type: string
          enum: [financial, reporting, information]
        metric:
          type: string
        operator:
          type: string
          enum: [">=", "<=", ">", "<", "=="]
        threshold:
          type: number
        frequency:
          type: string
          enum: [monthly, quarterly, annually]
        grace_period_days:
          type: integer
        notes:
          type: string

    CovenantTestResult:
      type: object
      required: [covenant_id, status, actual_value, threshold, tested_at]
      properties:
        covenant_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        covenant_name:
          type: string
        status:
          type: string
          enum: [pass, fail, warning, grace_period, waived]
        actual_value:
          type: number
        threshold:
          type: number
        operator:
          type: string
        metric:
          type: string
        tested_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        grace_period_expires:
          type: string
          format: date-time

    # ── Evaluate (Underwriting) ──
    EvaluateRequest:
      type: object
      properties:
        policy:
          type: object
          description: Lender policy configuration for the evaluation
          required: [policy_id, model]
          properties:
            policy_id:
              type: string
            model:
              type: string
              description: LLM model identifier
            persona:
              type: string
            target_yield_pct:
              type: number
            max_single_loan:
              type: number
            total_capital:
              type: number
            sector_limits:
              type: object
              additionalProperties:
                type: number
            params:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: true
        provider:
          type: string
          enum: [openrouter, anthropic]
          description: Reserved for future full-agent provider selection
        mode:
          type: string
          enum: [full, rules_only]
          default: full
          description: "full = LLM agent evaluation; rules_only = deterministic rules (thin agent fallback)"
        allow_rules_fallback:
          type: boolean
          default: false
          description: "Only when mode=full: if true, allows deterministic rules fallback when LLM is unavailable or fails"

    EvaluateResponse:
      type: object
      description: Structured UnderwritingRun result conforming to underwriting-run.schema.json
      required: [run_id, decision]
      properties:
        run_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        decision:
          type: object
          required: [action]
          properties:
            action:
              type: string
              enum: [approve, decline, counter, refer]
            terms:
              type: object
              properties:
                amount:
                  type: number
                apr:
                  type: number
                  description: "Decimal (0.095 = 9.5%)"
                tenor_months:
                  type: integer
            risk_grade:
              type: string
            confidence:
              type: number
        rationale:
          type: object
          properties:
            summary:
              type: string
            key_factors:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
            what_would_change:
              type: array
              items:
                type: string
        trace:
          type: object
          properties:
            steps:
              type: array
              items:
                type: object
            latency_ms:
              type: integer
            cost:
              type: object
              properties:
                tokens_in:
                  type: integer
                tokens_out:
                  type: integer
                estimated_cost_usd:
                  type: number

    # ── Error ──
    ApiError:
      type: object
      required: [error]
      properties:
        error:
          type: object
          required: [code, message]
          properties:
            code:
              type: string
            message:
              type: string
            details:
              type: object
              additionalProperties: true
            retryable:
              type: boolean
              default: false
